class: A test-data seeder that checks only an aggregate (a total, a booked P&L) can store a different event history than the scenario describes: the total still matches, so the seed reports success, while every reader of the history (counts, timelines, per-step pages) shows the wrong events.
mechanism: scripts/seed_scenario.py stored ADJ-13 as entry (2 history legs) + adjustment 1 (their exits) + adjustment 2 (all 4 current legs, including the never-adjusted call spread); the scenario says adjustments_used 1; booked P&L +962 matched, the only check.

first_seen.where: GC-MU A5 proof on ofo_dev (scenario ADJ-13, strategy 73)
first_seen.evidence: GET /api/strategies/73/adjustment-history -> 3 rows (entry, 1, 2); ADJ-13.json adjustments_used 1; Compare 'Adjustments used' reads 2 used

fix: Not fixed (#628): batch by the scenario's adjustment numbers; refuse the seed unless the engine's adjustments_used over the stored orders equals the scenario's.
